example_en: The farmer worked in the field bare-foot.

example_en: The fire was blazing in the yajna.

definition: a track or way worn by footsteps in a forest; a jungle-path.
example_en: The hunters walked taking the jungle path.

example_en: The filthiness of that place disgusted everyone.

definition: the step mother of one's husband.
example: ಬಲ ಅತ್ತೆ ಅವಳಿಗೆ ಸಿಹಿ ತಿಂಡಿ ಮಾಡಿ ಕೊಟ್ಟಳು.
example_en: Her husband's stepmother made sweets and gave them to her.

definition: a feeling of displeasure resulting from injury, mistreatment, opposition, etc., and usu. showing itself in a desire to fight back at the supposed cause of this feeling; anger.

example_en: The poor man used the old rag as a patch for his cloth.

example_en: He took a resolute vow to always speak the truth.

definition: a wise, intelligent man.

example_en: Being a wise man, he solved the village's problems intelligently.

definition: not natural; made in imitation of or as a substitute for something natural; pretended; artificial; fictitious.
example_en: This is not a real diamond, it is an artificial stone.

definition: a great quantity or store of money, valuable possessions, property or other riches; wealth; opulence.
example: ಆ ವ್ಯಾಪಾರಿಯ ಬಳಿ ಅಪಾರ ದವಲತ್ ಇತ್ತು.
example_en: That merchant had immense wealth.

definition: to explain or detail one's characteristics; to indicate the distinctive feature or features of.
example_en: He indicated his address in the application.

definition: (preceding negation) meagerly.

example_en: That poor family did not get even a meager meal.

definition: a mountainous region.
example_en: Tourists came to see the mountainous region.

definition: to have lustre; to be shining; to be or become lustrous.
example_en: The gold ornament was shining brightly.

definition: in front; to or towards front.
example_en: The soldiers who walked in front reached the fort.

definition: the act, fact or state of knowing; awareness of fact.
example: ಆ ಘಟನೆಯ ಅಱಿತ ಇಡೀ ಊರಿಗೆ ಇತ್ತು.
example_en: The whole village had awareness of that incident.

definition: a loose garment for covering the shoulders.
example_en: The ascetic had wrapped a loose garment over his shoulders.

definition: the sense of superiority and inferiority (used often to contrast each other).
example: ಇಬ್ಬರ ನಡುವೆ ಆಲಾ ಅದನಾ ಎಂಬ ಭಾವನೆ ಸ್ಪಷ್ಟವಾಗಿತ್ತು.
example_en: The sense of superiority and inferiority between the two was evident.

definition: a long unsewn cloth wound round the head, as a headgear.
example_en: Grandfather wrapped the long unsewn cloth around his head as a headgear.

definition: to host a feast.
example_en: They hosted a feast for the guests at the wedding.

definition: a kind of paddy .
example_en: They transplanted the musuvana variety of paddy in the field.

definition: the tree Albizzia amara (= A. wightii, = Mimosa amara) of Mimosae family, the powder of the dried leaves of which is mixed with soap-nut powder.
example: ಅವರು ಚಿಗರೆ ಎಲೆಗಳ ಪುಡಿಯನ್ನು ಸಾಬೂನಿನೊಂದಿಗೆ ಬೆರೆಸಿದರು.
example_en: They mixed the powder of the chigare leaves with soap.

definition: fine engraving works on the surface of a stone.
example: ದೇವಾಲಯದ ಕಲ್ಲಿನ ಮೇಲೆ ಸೂಕ್ಷ್ಮವಾದ ಕುಸುಕ ಕೆತ್ತಲಾಗಿದೆ.
example_en: Fine engraving work has been carved on the temple stone.

definition: a man having back that is humped in a convex position; a hump-backed man.
example_en: That hump-backed man was walking carrying a load.

definition: a variety in prosodic metres.
example_en: Chandovichitti is a variety in prosodic metres.

definition: that which is strengthless, sapless, hence, useless.
example_en: That dried stick, being sapless, broke.

definition: a strong, courageous man.
example_en: That strong, courageous man faced the tiger alone.

definition: an elephant in rut.
example_en: The elephant in rut was trumpeting in the forest with its trunk raised.

definition: the bellowing sound of a bull.
example_en: Hearing the bellowing, everyone ran outside.

definition: an oil that is used as or that which can be used as, burning agent; an inflammable oil.
example_en: He poured the inflammable oil into the lamp and lit it.

definition: a stance in sword fighting.
example_en: The teacher taught the disciple the sword-fighting stance.

definition: of or connected with administration; administrative.

definition: a man who leads; he who directs, commands or guides a group of people; a leader.

example_en: The leader of that group guided everyone properly.

definition: a set of hanging drapery for concealing all or part of the stage or set from the view of the audience; a curtain.
example_en: They drew back the curtain before the play began.

definition: to cause to move; to move or displace; to push.
example_en: She moved the chair aside and sat down.

definition: the plant Jatropha curcas of Euphorbiaceae family; castor plant.
example_en: The oil of the castor plant is used for medicine.

definition: a man who speaks well and sensibly.
example_en: In that assembly he alone was the man who spoke well and sensibly.

definition: a fight on or around the ramparts.
example_en: The enemy army engaged in a fight around the ramparts.

definition: the act of applying light touches or strokes to (a person or part of a person's body) so as to excite the nerves and usu. produce laughter and spasmodic movement; tickle; a tickling.
example: ಅವನು ಮಗುವಿನ ಹೊಟ್ಟೆಗೆ ಚಕ್ಕಳಗುಳಿ ಇಟ್ಟು ನಗಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: He tickled the child's belly and made it laugh.

definition: raised up; elevated; moved to a higher level.
example_en: That question was raised up again in the meeting.

definition: the state of being safe; freedom from the occurrence or risk of injury, danger or loss; safety.
example_en: The parents took care for the safety of the children.

definition: she who is benevolent, generous, gracious.
example_en: By the blessing of the benevolent goddess, happiness settled in the house.

definition: a friend of the hero (in Samskřta dramas).

definition: disarranged, untidy or uncombed and untrimmed moustache.

example_en: The grandfather's untrimmed moustache looked very charming from the front.

definition: an uncivilised man; a savage; a barbarian.
example_en: That barbarian lived alone in the forest.

definition: pervading; diffusing; sprading widely.
example: ಈ ಕಾನೂನಿನ ವ್ಯಾಪಕ ಪರಿಣಾಮ ಇಡೀ ದೇಶದ ಮೇಲಿದೆ.

definition: the sound made while weeping; sobbing sound.
example_en: The sound of the child's sobbing was heard from inside the house.

definition: a man who shoots arrows (from a bow); an archer.

example_en: That demon's ghastly act frightened everyone.

definition: an unequalled, unrivalled man.
example: ಆ ಕವಿಯು ತನ್ನ ಕಾಲದ ಅಪ್ರತಿಮ ಎನಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: That poet was regarded as unrivalled in his time.

definition: being thin and flat.

definition: completely; fully.

example_en: They tied ornamental metal cones on the oxen's horns as decoration.

definition: the grass Desmostachya tripinnata of Poaceae family; sacred grass.

definition: (pros.) a verse having two lines.

definition: in a small degree; to a slight extent; only slightly; not much.

example_en: In the rainy season the plant puts forth new sprouts.

definition: a creating or being created.
example: ಈ ಜಗತ್ತಿನ ಸೃಷ್ಟಿ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಅನೇಕ ಕಥೆಗಳಿವೆ.
example_en: There are many stories about the creation of this world.

definition: a year of any calendar.
example_en: This year passed well for us.

definition: a comb used to untangle the tangled hair.
example_en: The mother combed her daughter's tangled hair with the wide comb.

definition: a paroxysmal, often allergic disorder of respiration, characterised by bronchospasm, wheezing, and difficulty in expiration, often accompanied by coughing and a feeling of constriction in the chest or suffocating feeling; asthma.
example_en: Because of asthma, he has difficulty breathing.

definition: any of a large family (Aphididae) of small, soft-bodied homopteran insects that suck the juice from plants; a plant louse; an aphid.
example_en: Aphids swarmed on the buds.

definition: an acrobatic feat of an acrobat performed with a rope, cord, etc.
example_en: He performed a rope acrobatic feat on the stage.

definition: that which is useless or wasted.
example_en: Throw away that useless thing.

definition: a room where things are stored; a store-room.
example_en: They stored the rice in the store-room.

definition: a kind of vine.
example_en: The hālusōre vine had spread over the fence.

definition: a kind of stitch in which each movement of the thread is separated by a relatively more distance.
example_en: That embroidery had the pattern of the tibbi stitch.

definition: lacking normal intelligence; stupid; foolish.
example_en: He is very stupid, he understands nothing.

definition: desired by oneself.
example_en: This was a decision desired by himself.

definition: a man who is flying or can fly in the air.
example_en: That flying man soared high into the sky.

definition: to sever, fracture, to break.
example_en: The opinions of the two parties diverged.

definition: to convince and make another agree to.
example_en: The teacher convinced the student and continued the lesson.

definition: a short, metrical hymn in praise of a god; a hymn.
example_en: The priest recited a hymn in praise of the god.

definition: a group of persons; a troop.
example: ಸೈನಿಕರ ಒಂದು ತುರುಪು ಗಡಿಯ ಕಡೆ ಹೊರಟಿತು.
example_en: A troop of soldiers set out towards the border.

definition: a plant that lives on or in another plant and obtains nutriment from the later.
example_en: The parasitic plant gets nourishment from the tree.

definition: words of mouth (as differentiated from the writted words).
example: ಆ ಒಪ್ಪಂದ ಬಾಯ್ವಾತಿನಲ್ಲೇ ಉಳಿದು, ಬರೆಹಕ್ಕೆ ಬರಲಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: That agreement remained only as words of mouth and never came into writing.

definition: a region, district that is higher than adjacent land.
example_en: The region of Karunadu extends over higher land.

definition: warm breath.
example: ಓಟ ಮುಗಿಸಿದ ಬಳಿಕ ಅವನ ಉರಿಯುಸಿರು ಜೋರಾಗಿ ಕೇಳುತ್ತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: After finishing the run, his warm breath could be heard loudly.

definition: to come running.
example: ಮಳೆ ಬರುತ್ತಿದ್ದಂತೆ ಜನರು ಪರಿತರ್ ಎಂದು ಓಡಿ ಬಂದರು.
example_en: As the rain came, people came running quickly.

definition: a man employed for menial works; a servant.
example_en: The servant is watering the garden.

definition: a substance that through its chemical action usu. kills, injures or impairs an organism when consumed; poison.
example_en: He died after consuming poison.

definition: to flow, disperse, spread in an appropriate manner.
example_en: The rainwater flowed and spread evenly across the field.

definition: a thin, thread-like wire of gold or silver.
example: ಆ ಸೀರೆಯ ಅಂಚಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಚಿನ್ನದ ಸರಿಗೆ ನೇಯ್ದಿದ್ದರು.
example_en: They had woven gold thread-like wire on the border of that sari.

definition: a covering or decoration for the head; a head-dress.
example_en: At the wedding the bride wore a beautiful head-dress.

definition: a desire prompted by keenness, impatience and anxiety; eagerness.
example_en: She had a great eagerness to go to her village.

definition: brightness; splendour.
example: ಆ ಆಭರಣದ ಮೆಱಹು ಎಲ್ಲರ ಕಣ್ಣು ಸೆಳೆಯಿತು.
example_en: The brightness of that ornament caught everyone's eye.

definition: the early stage of conception; the inceptive stage of pregnancy.
example_en: The doctor confirmed that she was in the early stage of pregnancy.

definition: the quality or state of being excessive; excessiveness.
example: ಅವನ ಮಾತಿನ ಪರುಟವ ಎಲ್ಲರಿಗೂ ಬೇಸರ ತಂದಿತು.
example_en: The excessiveness of his talk bored everyone.

definition: pervading the all over the universe.
example: ಆ ದೈವಶಕ್ತಿ ಭುವನಗರ್ಭಿತವಾಗಿ ಎಲ್ಲೆಡೆ ಇದೆಯೆಂದು ಋಷಿಗಳು ಹೇಳಿದರು.
example_en: The sages said that divine power pervades the whole universe.

definition: the small or medium-sized, deciduous tree Cordia dichotoma ( = C. myxa) of Boraginaceae family.
example_en: People rested in the shade of the shelu tree.

definition: the tree Ormosia travancorica of Papilionaceae family.
example_en: The Ormosia travancorica tree grows in the dense forest.

definition: something that is given as a token of appreciation.
example: ಗುರುಗಳಿಗೆ ಶಿಷ್ಯ ಇನಾಯತವಾಗಿ ಒಂದು ಶಾಲು ನೀಡಿದನು.
example_en: The disciple gave a shawl to the teacher as a token of appreciation.
